title: Process Design Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Ingenious Engineering Pvt Ltd specializes in the manufacturing of high-quality OEM equipment customized to meet client specifications. Our expertise is built on robust in-house engineering and cutting-edge design capabilities. We take pride in delivering innovative, reliable, and efficient solutions. At Ingenious Engineering, we value precision, innovation, and customer satisfaction to meet the unique needs of our clients.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented
**Process / Design Engineer**
with a strong background in steel fabrication. The role involves translating client requirements into clear production processes, ensuring smooth coordination between design and manufacturing teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop
  **process sheets and flowcharts**
  for fabricated structures
* Analyze client drawings and specifications to define manufacturing processes
* Handle
  **technical queries and clarifications**
  with clients to support production
* Prepare accurate
  **Bill of Materials (BOM)**
  for fabrication and procurement
* Collaborate with production, procurement, and quality teams for efficient execution
* Maintain proper documentation for all engineering and process-related activities

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in
  **Mechanical Engineering**
* **3-5 years of experience in steel fabrication / engineering industry**
* **Strong understanding of fabrication processes and structural components**
* **Ability to read and interpret technical/mechanical drawings**
* **Experience in process planning and BOM preparation**
* **Good communication skills for client interaction and internal coordination**
* **Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities**

title: Graduate Apprentice Trainee
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
**About The NATS Program**
This role is offered under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS), a flagship initiative of the Government of India designed to equip Indian youth with practical, trade-specific skills. Administered under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 (amended in 1973), this program at Volvo Group offers engineering graduates and diploma holders a structured, 1-year practical, hands-on On-the-Job Training (OJT) opportunity to build industry-ready capabilities.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Standard operating procedures preparation & frequent validation
* One point lesson preparation & frequent validation
* Additional instructions, Temporary instructions preparation & frequent validation
* Distribution of Sprint to Production team
* Distribution of Batch change report to Production team
* Support in Value added & non-value-added activities study on Production line- Time study, Spaghetti chart for motion study
* Support in Ergonomic studies on Production line, improvement concept development & implement
* Support to work on process & quality issues to have temporary & permanent action
* Validation & updation of tooling list
* Working on layout modification preparation/updation in AutoCAD
* Prepare local tooling drawing
* Support in TR validation & Process audits
* Sprint Vs Actual process validation
* Sprint Vs Actual bill of material validation
* Support in documentation & data analysis

**Who are you?**

* You have completed B.E in ­Mechanical / Automobile / Electronics and Communication / Electrical and Electronics Engineering

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
  
  
**Who We Are And What We Believe In**
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
  
  
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
**Volvo Group**
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
  
  
**Trucks Technology & Industrial Division**
hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.
  
  
Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Technical Bid Manager
description:
**About the Business:**




  





 Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
 



 Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.
 



 Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.
 



  





**Responsibilities**



* Own end\-to\-end technical bid governance, ensuring bid readiness from RFQ receipt through final submission and management approval.
* Lead RFQ decomposition, requirements analysis, compliance matrix development, and requirements traceability to ensure customer requirements are fully captured and addressed.
* Establish proposal architecture, bid strategy, solution storytelling, and executive\-level presentations to communicate compelling customer solutions.
* Drive go/no\-go decisions, pricing gate reviews, approval milestones, and bid governance reviews, ensuring risks, assumptions, and deviations are visible to decision\-makers.
* Manage proposal review cycles, including Red Team and Gold Team reviews, and ensure timely closure of all review actions.
* Coordinate and prioritize resources across multiple concurrent bid opportunities while maintaining bid quality and submission timelines.
* Review customer RFQs, drawings, specifications, BOMs, standards, and technical data packages to identify gaps, risks, assumptions, and clarification needs.
* Develop structured customer clarification logs and convert incomplete requirements into documented assumptions, dependencies, closure plans, and executable solutions.
* Define solution approaches, basis of estimate, implementation strategies, assumptions, exclusions, risks, and mitigation plans.
* Prepare auditable technical evidence, compliance documentation, proposal narratives, management approval packages, and supporting bid artifacts.
* Develop resource plans, cycle\-time estimates, equipment and tooling requirements, NRE, capital expenditure estimates, implementation schedules, and milestone plans.



  





**Qualifications:**



* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, ECE, Industrial or a related engineering discipline. PMP and/or MBA is preferred.



  





**Desired Experience Level:**



* Expertise in RFQ decomposition, bid governance, requirements traceability, compliance management, and proposal development.
* Strong knowledge of technical bid management methodologies, gated review processes, and proposal lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in developing compliance matrices, risk registers, action trackers, requirements traceability registers, and governance documentation.
* Experience creating technical proposals, executive presentations, customer\-facing solution narratives, and management approval packages.
* Strong commercial awareness with the ability to evaluate cost, schedule, risk, contract deliverables, and business impacts.
* Knowledge of manufacturing industrialization, NPI processes, EMS operations, process engineering, quality systems, test strategies, and supply chain considerations.
* Ability to develop resource loading models, cycle\-time calculations, capacity assessments, equipment requirements, tooling estimates, implementation schedules, and capital investment evaluations.
* Experience with ERP, PLM, document management repositories, BOM management systems, and controlled content environments.
* Understanding of change control, configuration management, estimation methodologies, technical documentation, and proposal costing principles.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving capabilities with the ability to make evidence\-based technical and commercial recommendations.
* Proven capability to lead multidisciplinary teams and collaborate effectively across engineering, operations, quality, sourcing, finance, and supplier organizations.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent bids, work under fixed deadlines, and maintain high levels of accuracy and attention to detail.

title: R&D Application Chemist III
description:
Business Unit: MAES
   

  

 Division: Packaging \& Board Assembly
   

  

**Challenge Yourself and Impact the Future!**
 MacDermid Alpha Electronics Solutions, a business segment of Element Solutions Inc (NYSE: ESI), is renowned worldwide for its commitment to revolutionizing the electronics industry. With a legacy spanning over a century, we have continually set new benchmarks for excellence, reliability and sustainability in electronic materials.
   

  

  

* Wafer Level Packaging \- Revolutionizing wafer fabrication processes for enhanced efficiency and performance
* Circuitry Solutions \- Tailored solutions to meet the dynamic demands of modern circuitry
* Electronics Assembly Solutions \- Innovating semiconductor, surface mount technology, and power electronics assembly for unparalleled reliability
* Advanced Materials and Joining \- Engineering polymer and metal joining solutions for optimally performing circuits
* Film \& Smart Surface Solutions \- Transforming electronics with cutting\-edge materials and technologies for enhanced functionality and reliability
* Micromax – Elevating electronics through high\-performing, specialized inks and pastes


 Across diverse sectors including automotive, consumer electronics, mobile devices, telecom, data storage, infrastructure, and AI, MacDermid Alpha Electronics Solutions has earned the trust of manufacturers worldwide. Our comprehensive range of high\-quality solutions and technical services enables the entire electronics supply chain, empowering businesses to thrive in today's competitive landscape.
   

  

 We embody the 'Elements of our Culture'\- our 5C's; Challenge, Commit, Collaborate, Choose, and Care. These core values are the foundation of our organization which our employees embrace in their interactions with customers, colleagues and other stakeholders, to drive financial performance and create a rewarding work environment.
   

  

**Who are we looking for?**
* We’re looking for a practical, creative, and extremely talented hands\-on Chemist, Material Scientist or a Chemical Engineer to join our customer support applications \& development team.
* The R\&D Application Chemist will provide high\-quality technical support \& solutions to CS \& WLP customers in India, strive to deliver analytical solutions, conduct method development and validation that support customer applications, troubleshooting and product development.


**What will you be doing?**
* Characterizing and optimizing existing and newly developed products for electrodeposition of metals for the semiconductor industry
* Design and execute physical and chemical analytical methods to support customer applications such as analysis of customer plating bath chemistries using wet chemical methods, titrations, and CVS, followed by interpretation of results and technical reporting.
* Able to observe, analyze, calculate and interpret results, prepare professional reports and recommend further action based on results.
* Develop and validate new analytical methods in alignment with customer and business needs.
* Conduct failure mode analysis, identify defects and material\-related issues, and recommend improvement solutions.
* Maintain and calibrate laboratory instruments to ensure compliance with internal and external quality standards.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Technical Service Engineers, and Product Teams to support key customer projects.
* Ensure laboratory safety, cleanliness, and adherence to EHS (Environmental, Health, and Safety) policies.
* Prepare technical documentation, SOPs, and customer reports.
* Monitor lab KPIs and continuously improve lab efficiency and service quality.
* Maintain 5S standards in the laboratory to ensure safe and efficient operations.
* Travel within India as required to support customers through meetings and production line process optimization


**Who are You?**
* Master’s degree in chemistry, Engineering or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in technical application support and/or development within surface plating industries.
* Strong understanding of electrochemistry and surface chemistry
* Experience with plating bath formulation, control, and troubleshooting
* Familiarity with analytical and characterization techniques relevant to metal coatings


**What competencies will you need?**
* Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of physical and chemical analysis techniques, instrumentation, and method development.
* Customer Orientation: Ability to understand customer needs and deliver technical solutions that add value.
* Project Management: Skilled in planning, prioritizing, and executing multiple projects within deadlines.
* Problem Solving: Analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and propose effective solutions.
* Communication Skills: Clear and professional communication in both English and Chinese, including technical reporting and customer interaction.
* Collaboration: Ability to work cross\-functionally with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Continuous Improvement: Commitment to driving innovation, improving lab processes, and adopting new technologies.
* Compliance \& Safety Awareness: Strong understanding of laboratory safety standards, regulatory requirements, and quality systems


**We are Offering...**
 As part of our team here, in addition to a competitive Gross Salary you will be eligible to participate in a generous performance related bonus scheme. In addition, you will receive 3 comprehensive insurance benefits 1\. GMC (Self/ Spouse and 2 Kids – INR 5 Lakhs coverage), 2\. GPA – 5 Times of Annual Salary sum assured for Employee, 3\. GTLI \- 5 Times of Annual Salary sum assured for Employee. Also as an Employee benefit we offer free 2 meals on all working days.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category applicable under federal, state and local laws.

title: Process Lead - Pack & Product Traceability
description:
**Responsibilities** 



* Own packaging and product traceability architecture, including pack\-out design, serialization strategy, unit genealogy, and as\-built traceability requirements.
* Develop packaging solutions that meet customer, regulatory, logistics, and manufacturing requirements while ensuring product protection and operational efficiency.
* Define packaging validation requirements, including ISTA/ASTM transit qualification and packaging conformance evidence.
* Review RFQs, drawings, BOMs, specifications, and customer standards to identify packaging and traceability requirements, risks, and gaps.
* Develop estimates for packaging materials, labeling systems, traceability infrastructure, equipment requirements, NRE, capex, and implementation timelines.
* Define process assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, risks, and mitigation plans supporting bid and costing activities.
* Establish labeling, barcode, QR code, serialization, and data capture requirements across manufacturing and logistics processes.
* Support supplier evaluations, packaging material selection, and make\-versus\-buy assessments for packaging and traceability solutions.
* Prepare auditable technical documentation, calculations, and compliance evidence to support proposals and management approvals.
* Define validation, traceability, and handover requirements to ensure seamless transition into NPI and production execution.



  





**Qualifications** 



* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, ECE, Mechatronics, Industrial, Production Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Postgraduate specialization in Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related discipline preferred.
* Strong knowledge of packaging engineering, product traceability, serialization, labeling systems, and logistics requirements.
* Experience with ISTA and ASTM packaging validation standards, transit testing methodologies, and packaging qualification processes.
* Knowledge of DFM, PFMEA, Control Plans, process capability, and manufacturing quality systems.
* Expertise in manufacturing process design, capacity modelling, cycle\-time analysis, and cost estimation methodologies.
* Proficiency in advanced Excel modelling, process simulation tools, and packaging or labeling system technologies.
* Working knowledge of PLM, ERP, and MES systems supporting product genealogy, traceability, BOM management, routings, and work instructions.



  





**Desired Experience Level** 



* 8\-12 years of experience in Packaging Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Product Traceability, NPI, Manufacturing Industrialization, or EMS operations.
* Demonstrated experience supporting customer RFQs, technical proposals, and manufacturing solution development within EMS or complex product manufacturing environments.
* Proven experience in packaging design, serialization strategies, product genealogy, and end\-to\-end traceability implementation.
* Experience developing packaging validation plans, transit qualification strategies, and compliance documentation for customer programs.
* Strong ability to convert incomplete customer requirements into executable packaging and traceability solutions with clearly defined assumptions, risks, and mitigation plans.
* Experience collaborating with global customers, suppliers, quality, operations, and supply chain teams to deliver scalable and compliant manufacturing solutions.

title: Website Manager
description:
**Organisation Name:** 
 One World One Family Mission
 



**Job Title:** 
 Website Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Muddenahalli, Karnataka
 



  





**About Us:** 




 One World One Family Mission provides free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare to those in need across 100 countries. Under the visionary leadership of the globally acclaimed humanitarian, Sadguru Sri Madhusudan Sai, the Organisation is dedicated to uplifting the most marginalised communities. The mission is grounded in the ethos of selfless service, guided by the belief that all are a part of ‘One World, One Family’.
 



  





**About the Mission’s websites** 



1. Mission Website \- The Mission has its own website which provides an overview of the mission and the member organisations worldwide. This is managed by the Mission Website Team.



  




1. Parent Trusts and Foundations \- In addition to this, there are parent trusts and foundations in India that primarily focus on specific verticals (Health, Education, Nutrition). Many of these organisations have their own websites, which are managed by dedicated website teams, while others are managed by the Mission Website Team.



  




1. Institutional Websites \- The Mission also manages multiple institutions such as Hospitals, Schools, Colleges and Universities. The Mission Website Team provides advice, guidance and instructions on the content, branding, function and usability of these sites.



  




1. Country Websites \- For countries in which our organisation has a presence, some of them have their own websites. Many of these countries do not have a website. However, for those that do, their websites are managed by local teams. The Mission Website Team provides advice, guidance and instructions on the content, branding, function and usability of these sites.



  





 The Mission is currently undergoing a rebranding phase wherein we are consolidating and enhancing the existing websites to ensure that it is clear to website visitors that all these websites fall under one Mission.
 



  





**Position Description** 




 The Website Manager will be responsible for the management, maintenance and enhancement of the key websites under the
 **One World One Family Mission** 
 . The role will ensure that all websites remain accurate, up\-to\-date, secure, user\-friendly, and aligned with the mission's vision, values, and objectives.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Website Management \& Operations** 



* Manage and oversee all websites under the One World One Family Mission.
* Ensure websites are regularly updated with relevant and accurate content.
* Monitor website functionality, performance, and availability.
* Maintain consistency in design, branding, content, and user experience across all mission websites.
* Implement website enhancement initiatives and support new website launches when required.
* For mission websites that are managed by other individuals and parties, the Website Manager is responsible for providing support, guidance and instructions to ensure that these websites maintain a standard of care, quality and professionalism and are in line with the Mission’s branding guidelines.
* Initiate and manage a dashboard or ticketing system for managing website updates.



**2\. Content Management** 



* Coordinate with departments, project teams, and content owners to collect and publish website content.
* Establish a systematic review process to ensure information remains current and relevant.
* Update news, events, announcements, programs, reports, and other digital content regularly.
* Ensure content follows organisational guidelines and quality standards.
* In areas where there are no existing processes or guidelines, the Website Manager is responsible for defining and developing new processes/guidelines.



**3\. Stakeholder Coordination** 



* Act as the central point of contact for all website\-related requirements.
* Collaborate with mission leaders, departments, partners, and external vendors for website updates and improvements.
* Gather stakeholder requirements and translate them into actionable website enhancements.
* Facilitate periodic review meetings to address website needs and priorities.



**4\. Website Governance \& Quality Assurance** 



* Conduct regular audits of website content, links, forms, and functionality.
* Ensure compliance with organisational standards, accessibility requirements, and digital best practices.
* Maintain documentation related to website structures, processes, and update logs.
* Ensure information accuracy and consistency across all websites.



**5\. Technical Coordination** 



* Liaise with developers, hosting providers, and IT teams for website maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Monitor website security, backups, software updates, and performance optimization.
* Coordinate implementation of new features, integrations, and technical improvements.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical issues affecting website operations.



**6\. Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Monitor website traffic, engagement, and performance metrics.
* Generate periodic reports on website usage and effectiveness.
* Provide recommendations to improve user experience, engagement, and website performance.
* Track the impact of digital initiatives and content updates.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Digital Media, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
* 8\-10 years of experience in website management, digital communications, or related roles, including at least 2 years in a role leading or supervising a team.
* Extensive experience working with Content Management Systems (CMS) such as WordPress or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with website analytics and digital marketing tools.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Strong organisational and project management skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Strong working knowledge of website technologies, hosting, and security practices, sufficient to liaise confidently with developers and IT teams and troubleshoot issues independently where possible. Solid understanding of SEO, accessibility standards, and digital best practices.
* Able to work on tight deadlines to ensure websites are updated on a timely basis, and establish/adhere to agreed SLA timelines.
* Demonstrated experience managing and developing a small team, including delegating responsibilities, setting priorities, and building team capability over time.
* Able to confidently communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Able to collaborate with other teams, including the content team, institutional leadership, design team, branding team and social media team.
* Able to manage multiple websites and priorities simultaneously.



  





**Location/Work Environment:** 
 This is a full\-time on\-site job role.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




  





 Joining the OWOF mission offers a chance to impact marginalized communities globally. With a focus on free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare across 100 countries, your efforts directly contribute to positive change. Being part of our mission means experiencing the joy of helping others and knowing your contributions bring happiness to those in need.
